+def _get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir: pathlib.Path, locale_name: str) -> pathlib.Path:
+    """Return the path to the Chromium locale resource for *locale_name*."""
+    return pathlib.Path(locales_dir) / (locale_name + '.pak')
+
+
+def _get_lang_override(versions: version.WebEngineVersions,
+                       locale_name: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return a Chromium language override if the system locale pack is missing."""
+    if (not config.val.qt.workarounds.locale or not utils.is_linux or
+            versions.webengine != utils.VersionNumber(5, 15, 3)):
+        return None
+
+    locale_name = locale_name.split('.', 1)[0].replace('_', '-')
+    from PyQt5.QtCore import QLibraryInfo
+    locales_dir = pathlib.Path(QLibraryInfo.location(QLibraryInfo.DataPath)) / \
+        'qtwebengine_locales'
+    if _get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir, locale_name).exists():
+        return None
+
+    base_language = locale_name.split('-', 1)[0]
+
+    def chromium_locale(name: str) -> str:
+        """Map a locale to the pack Chromium uses for that locale."""
+        if name == 'en' or name in ('en-LR', 'en-PH'):
+            return 'en-US'
+        if name.startswith('en-'):
+            if name in {'en-GB', 'en-AU', 'en-CA', 'en-IE', 'en-IN',
+                        'en-NZ', 'en-ZA', 'en-ZW'}:
+                return 'en-GB'
+            return 'en-US'
+        if name == 'es' or name.startswith('es-'):
+            return 'es'
+        if name == 'pt':
+            return 'pt-BR'
+        if name.startswith('pt-'):
+            return 'pt-PT' if name == 'pt-PT' else 'pt-BR'
+        if name == 'zh' or name.startswith('zh-'):
+            return 'zh-TW' if name in ('zh-HK', 'zh-MO', 'zh-TW') else 'zh-CN'
+        return base_language
+
+    alternatives = (base_language, chromium_locale(locale_name),
+                    chromium_locale(base_language))
+    for candidate in alternatives:
+        pak_path = _get_locale_pak_path(locales_dir, candidate)
+        if candidate != locale_name and pak_path.exists():
+            return candidate
+    return 'en-US'
+
